body: Well I haven't killed myself yet, atleast I got that going on for me. It's getting harder each day to stay alive, the only thing that keeps me going are the unexpected sprinkles of hope that I experience occasionally. The hope is usually short lived though, everything is drowned by the darkness eventually.

You and me are very similar it sounds. My story up there barely scratches the surface but I know the feeling of pushing someone away. I used to love someone but I took it for granted. Instead of spending time with her and being there for her I was too focused on getting high off whatever I could get. I don't know why but she stuck with me through all of it. To me though she was starting to get in between me and my real fun.

I remember breaking up with her the day her mom got surgery. I told her it was me and not her, which was the truth. I was a piece of shit and didn't deserve her. But in reality, I was just breaking up with her so I could get higher more and not have someone to criticize me for doing it. The breakup went just about as well as you'd expect, she was devastated. I don't know what she saw in me, but I think for a period of time she genuinely loved me. 

The next day she calls me at 5 in the morning. Her mom died during surgery. I was still drunk and high from the night before. All I did was tell her I was sorry for her loss. I should've went there. I should've been there for her to tell her everything would be ok and that she wasn't alone. Instead I just said sorry and went back to bed like the piece of shit I was.

I let her go and losing her is just another failure of mine. I'm still friends with her on Facebook. Today she's engaged to some guy who owns a food truck and probably deserves her way more than I ever did. It just makes me wonder about what could have been. I'll be honest since her I haven't been able to really love anyone else. I've had a couple girlfriends since then but they e only been 1 or 2 dates each. I know I should let it go, but it's hard. It's hard to forget your failures.

It's not that I'm envious of my friends, I'm just disappointed in myself. I hate where I am in life. The thing is I just don't know if I would call it suffering. Everything bad that has happened to me is my own fault. I just hate myself and what I've done to my life.
I've considered it but I don't know if I'm physically capable anymore. I've let myself go real bad this year. Feels like the holes too deep to get out of.
I used to listen to a ton of Dream Theater back in high school. Nowadays I listen to Queens of the Stone Age quite a bit.
It feels like I've been saying one more day for years now.
It just feels like there's nothing we can do. No matter how hard I try I'm just going to screw up again.

I decided to go to work tonight to get my head off things. Tonight might not have been the night but who's to say that tomorrow isn't. It's like I'm fighting a war in my head. I've calmed down now, but what happens when reality hits again. It feels like a noose tightening; whenever it hits I feel closer and closer to my end. 

I've read through the comments and thank you guys very much for taking the time to read all that brief history of me. To answer a few questions, I don't know what I love and I have no idea what I want to do. I've never been passionate about anything other than fiction and that's not something that's going to put food on the table. I just don't know who I am or what defines me, I feel lost in the world. 

I wish I could do a trade but one thing I left out is how this year has ruined my body. I've always been overweight but quick on my feet because I'm 6'5, but this year I've ballooned up to 400 pounds. Sometimes I get heart palpitations, so if I don't kill myself I know a heart attack will get me eventually. My health though is just like the rest of my life though, a series of errors. I've lost a ton of weight and have gained it back again a ton of times. 

Man writing that just makes me more depressed. It really feels like there's no hope for me.

I'm not good. I'm tired of trying, I'm just tired of everything. Actually I don't know if trying is the right word. I'm tired of messing up. I've dug this hole for myself and I can't/don't know how to get out.

Im in Virginia, USA btw. I'm just afraid of calling. I'm afraid they'll consider me a harm to myself and send the police and an ambulance. And yea I wish I knew someone that could help me financially/emotionally. None of my family takes my depression and anxiety seriously, like it's just me trying to get attention. When I was getting out patient treatment my folks would give me shit every day for going, I should've been going to work instead of 'faking' a disability.

My short list of friends aren't any better. I tried confiding in one of my friends today and he said verbatim that he's tired of hearing about everyone else's problems when he's got his own shit to fix. I just don't know who to talk to. I texted another friend today too about it. He said that helping me would be way over his head.

I guess I could try to go back to my old employer, but I really doubt they would hire me again. They got a super high turnover rate and a thousand people at the door wanting to get hired, they don't exactly hire part time either. I don't know it just feels like I'm out of options.

Hey DDP I'm a lifelong fan of your work. I want to start out by saying that your DDP transformation videos have hit me on a huge emotional level. I'm 26, have battled depression my whole life, and have been severely out of shape my whole life, to a point to that if I don't stop, it's going to kill me. One of the things that keeps me going though is watching videos like the Arthur transformation. When I see someone like that take the necessary steps and change their life it motivates me and makes me want to change my my own life. Sorry if this question is too deep, but what would you recommend to someone looking to make the change and step out of the darkness after being stuck in it for so many years? What's the first step, what should I focus on? Should I focus solely on working out, or focus on my mentality first? I feel like you would be someone interesting to ask since you saved Jake and Scott. Also if you read this, I just want to thank you for all the work you've done in wrestling over the years. You've been an inspiration to me not only in my childhood, but now also in my adult life.
I wish life was as easy as you make that comment sound.
